_comment: The toolbar over the plots in the emtk app: the working path and Browse, then the 2-D map's colours (colormap, log counts, colour limits, Contrast, Update) -- plot_main.ui's first row and the colour controls of its widget_6 corner. One line when the window is wide enough; a narrow one wraps it before the colours, each line starting at the left edge. The rest of widget_6 is in the corner between the marginals (plot_corner).
